top_posts.author: paladinten17
top_posts.text:
$CADL 
Enough with the conferences, investor presentations, and fireside chats. Talk, talk, talk. Then, in one afternoon, nearly half the company’s market value goes up in smoke. WTF?

Does Tak understand the magnitude of this failure? Shareholders don’t need another reassuring presentation. They need answers, accountability, and a credible plan to fix this mess.

Enough fireside chats. It’s time
